notes.en: Adds scoped Sessions search with highlighted user-input previews and remembers the coding-agent selection across Sessions and launch pickers.
notes.zh-CN: 新增限定范围的会话搜索与高亮用户输入预览，并在会话与启动选择器之间记住所选编程代理。

notes.en: Fixes Claude/Codex startup with repository symlinks, improves native session titles and the quit-session tree, and captures agent stderr in service-monitor transcripts.
notes.zh-CN: 修复仓库符号链接导致的 Claude/Codex 启动问题，改进原生会话标题与退出会话树，并在服务监控记录中捕获代理标准错误输出。

notes.en: Cross-compiled zai CLI packages built from one pinned source revision.
notes.zh-CN: 由同一份固定源代码修订版交叉编译出的 zai CLI 安装包。

notes.en: Release archives are published publicly while the application source stays private.
notes.zh-CN: 应用源代码保持私有，仅公开发布安装包。

notes.en: Every archive is unsigned; verify the SHA-256 shown on the download page.
notes.zh-CN: 所有压缩包均未签名；请核对下载页显示的 SHA-256 校验值。

installNotes.en: Unsigned build. Install with the one-line installer, which verifies this archive's SHA-256, installs the zai family under your home directory, and updates the Windows user PATH or common macOS/Linux shell profiles. Open a new terminal and run zai. Python 3.10 or newer is required to install. Install your chosen coding-agent CLI separately; Node.js/npm is needed for supported npm-based provisioning.
installNotes.zh-CN: 未签名的构建。请使用一行安装命令；它会校验该压缩包的 SHA-256，把 zai 应用系列安装到主目录下，并更新 Windows 用户 PATH 或常见的 macOS/Linux shell 配置文件。打开新终端后运行 zai。安装需要 Python 3.10 及以上。请另行安装所选编程代理 CLI；支持的 npm 安装方式需要 Node.js/npm。
